BloomFilter.name: BloomFilter
BloomFilter.description: Creates a bloom/glow effect around bright areas to simulate light bleeding

edgeBlur.name: edgeBlur
edgeBlur.description:
How much more should the edge/corner of the screen blur? This reproduces CRT screens which would be
well focussed in the middle and slightly unfocused in the corners

ColorAdjustmentFilter.name: ColorAdjustmentFilter
ColorAdjustmentFilter.description:
Adjusts gamma, saturation, and brightness for final color calibration. Can be put anywhere
in the filters chain. One use is to counter-act if the other filters such as phosphor mask filter
have had an overall desaturating effect

brightnessBottom.name: brightnessBottom
brightnessBottom.description:
Extra brightness at bottom of screen (-1 to 1, 0 = no gradient). Positive values brighten the bottom, negative darken it,
simulates variable brightness on the round tube.

bloom.name: bloom
bloom.description: Bloom filter options, undefined to use defaults, false to disable

colorAdjustment.name: colorAdjustment
colorAdjustment.description: Color adjustment filter options, undefined to use defaults, false to disable

curvature.name: curvature
curvature.description: Curvature filter options, undefined to use defaults, false to disable

phosphorMask.name: phosphorMask
phosphorMask.description: Phosphor mask filter options, undefined to use defaults, false to disable

raiseBlackPoint.name: raiseBlackPoint
raiseBlackPoint.description: Raise black point filter options, undefined to use defaults, false to disable

roundedCorners.name: roundedCorners
roundedCorners.description: Rounded corners filter options, undefined to use defaults, false to disable

scanlines.name: scanlines
scanlines.description: Scanlines filter options, undefined to use defaults, false to disable

vignette.name: vignette
vignette.description: Vignette filter options, undefined to use defaults, false to disable

CurvatureFilter.name: CurvatureFilter
CurvatureFilter.description: Emulates the curved look of projecting onto a rounded glass screen

multisampling.name: multisampling
multisampling.description:
Enable multisampling (FSAA) for smoother curvature, but also slower rendering.
Also add some blurring.

NoiseFilter.name: NoiseFilter
NoiseFilter.description: Adds animated noise to simulate analog video interference and screen grain

fps.name: fps
fps.description: Noise FPS - frequency at which the noise updates per second

scale.name: scale
scale.description: Noise scale - larger values create bigger noise pixels

PhosphorMaskFilter.name: PhosphorMaskFilter
PhosphorMaskFilter.description:
Simulates the RGB phosphor dot pattern of CRT displays by creating vertical red, green, and blue stripes.
Only a slot mask is supported, since this was the most common type used in TVs and arcades.

maskBrightness.name: maskBrightness
maskBrightness.description:
Brightness of the mask pattern (0-1). This is the brightness of the 'off' pixels - a value of 1
turns the phosphor mask effect off entirely. A value of 0 means only pure red, green, and blue
pixels will be on

numSamples.name: numSamples
numSamples.description:
Number of samples for antialiasing (1 = off, 2-8 recommended). Setting this higher can
avoid Moire patterns, but is slower to render. Try adjusting in combination with the transition
width to get a good compromise.

transitionWidth.name: transitionWidth
transitionWidth.description:
how smooth is the transition between R,G,B phosphors.
0 = hard edge, 1 = very smooth

A hard edge (0) is more authentic, but can produce moire patterns,
especially with small pixelWidth and a low number of samples.

RaiseBlackPointFilter.name: RaiseBlackPointFilter
RaiseBlackPointFilter.description: Raises the black point of the image, simulating how older CRT screens couldn't produce perfect blacks

blackPoint.name: blackPoint
blackPoint.description:
Simulates how older screens couldn't make perfect blacks by compressing the dynamic range slightly.
0 means no effect (same as not having the filter, whereas a value like 0.1 would be a very strong effect

RoundedCornersFilter.name: RoundedCornersFilter
RoundedCornersFilter.description:
Adds rounded corners to the screen edges to simulate the physical shape of CRT displays.
This is separate from, but related to, the CurvatureFilter, which distorts the image to simulate the curved glass screen.

cornerRadius.name: cornerRadius
cornerRadius.description: Corner radius as proportion of screen size (0-0.1)

ScanlinesFilter.name: ScanlinesFilter
ScanlinesFilter.description: Creates horizontal scanlines to simulate CRT display raster lines

gapBrightness.name: gapBrightness
gapBrightness.description:
Brightness of the gap between scanlines (0-1). Setting this to 1 turns scanlines off entirely.
Setting to 0 makes hard, dark scanlines.

pixelHeight.name: pixelHeight
pixelHeight.description: Height of each scanline in pixels

VignetteFilter.name: VignetteFilter
VignetteFilter.description: Darkens the edges of the screen to simulate the natural light falloff on CRT displays

radius.name: radius
radius.description: Radius from center where vignette starts
